2105-3603-4885-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-3603-4885-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-3603-4885-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Cloudshift from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Cloudshift from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Cloudshift, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

1339-2438-7920.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-2438-7920.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Tresserhorn's Lord triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

225-728-2577-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
225-728-2577-7084.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the land.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

728-5617-6553.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

1594-4399-4518-6720.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Helm of Awakening.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Case of the Uneaten Feast trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Case of the Uneaten Feast trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1594-4399-4518-6720.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more oil counters on it

101-1987-3120.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
101-1987-3120.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Vampire Charmseeker.
When Vampire Charmseeker enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
101-1987-3120.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

1874-6824-7690.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1874-6824-7690.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token.
When the Wall enters, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.
1874-6824-7690.notes: The +1/+1 counter can be placed on any Hero you control except Invisible Woman. Spider-Man is used above for simplicity.

4013-4377-5531.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three Islands.
4013-4377-5531.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons for its buyback cost by paying {4}{U}{U} and sacrificing three Islands, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and return Walk the Aeons to your hand.
Blink Lumra using Eldrazi Displacer.
When Lumra enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards and then return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1251-2155-3259.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature with the greatest power among creatures on the battlefield.
1251-2155-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1251-2155-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Éomer of the Riddermark as attackers.
Éomer of the Riddermark triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

240-1251-5231-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing an Egg token, adding {R}
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Etali, Primal Conqueror // Etali, Primal Sickness

997-4294-5220.description:
Cast Etali by paying {5}{R}{R}.
When Etali enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Etali.
When Etali dies Mortuary triggers, putting Etali on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from Step 3, keeping Etali on the top of your library.
Resolve the Etali trigger from step 2, causing you to exile cards from each player's library until you exile a nonland card, with you exiling Etali from your library.
Cast Etali and any other nonland cards exiled this way without paying their mana costs.
Repeat from Step 2.

1395-2113-5051-5078.description:
Activate Traxos by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

457-1329-2350-3338-7112.description:
If Aether Spellbomb is in your graveyard, activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Aether Spellbomb.
Cast Aether Spellbomb either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Stone Calendar.
Mirran Spy triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Aether Spellbomb, adding {U}.
Activate Aether Spellbomb's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing it, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

479-7100.easyPrerequisites: You have 13 or fewer cards in hand.
479-7100.description:
During the end step before your turn, cast Stroke of Genius by paying {15}{U} minus {1} for each card in your hand, causing you to draw cards until you have thirteen cards in hand.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Triskaidekaphile triggers, causing you to win the game.
479-7100.notes: The cost can be reduced by {X}, where X equals the number of cards in your hand as you cast Stroke of Genius.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

304-539-3000-3899-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Tough Cookie.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

1739-2060-4770-6930.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {W}.
Spider-Man India triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

5638-6556-7070.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two creatures with power 4 or greater.
You control at least four Equipment.
5638-6556-7070.description:
Activate Plate Armor's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The Plate Armor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to Temur Battlecrier.
Repeat.

2099-2478-2866-4986.description:
Cast Mishra's Bauble by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

431-851-4772-6753.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-851-4772-6753.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of eight 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

1417-2073-6808.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is 13 or higher.
You control a creature with power 2 or greater.
1417-2073-6808.description:
Activate The Last Ride's crew ability by tapping a creature with power 2 or greater, causing it to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
The Last Ride dies as a state-based action due to having 0 or less toughness, triggering Salvaging Station and Bridge from Below.
Resolve the Bridge from Below trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Salvaging Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning The Last Ride from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2558-6291-6757-6798.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters the battlefield, Weapons Manufacturing triggers.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Thopter.
Repeat from step 2.
2558-6291-6757-6798.notes: You can sacrifice the Munitions tokens to Umbral Collar Zealot to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

3384-4550-5567-6798--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
3384-4550-5567-6798--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

2919-3197-6097.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2919-3197-6097.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1981-4416-6097-6740.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 3.
You control two untapped Soldiers.
1981-4416-6097-6740.description:
Declare Phyrexian Vindicator as an attacker.
Holding priority, activate Catapult Squad by tapping two Soldiers, attempting to deal 2 damage to Phyrexian Vindicator.
The damage is prevented due to Phyrexian Vindicator's replacement effect. Phyrexian Vindicator triggers, dealing 2 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating two 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
When the Soldiers enter the battlefield, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1651-3094-3349-4659.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Glissa triggers, choosing the first mode.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Glissa's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Glissa's trigger, creating two Incubator tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Incubators, untapping Lithoform Engine.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing an Incubator, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

772-5231-6553.easyPrerequisites: Shade's Form attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
772-5231-6553.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Shade's Form triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Shade's Form from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Repeat.

1170-3821-4124.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {G}{G}.
1170-3821-4124.description:
Activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {G}{G}.
Cast Whip Silk by paying its mana cost, targeting Displacer Kitten
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Peregrine Drake.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Resolve the Whip Silk spell.
Activate Whip Silk by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1477-1750-2793-5131-5261.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
When Ugin's Nexus is sacrificed, it is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Pull from Eternity without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Pull from Eternity, putting Ugin's Nexus from exile into your graveyard.
Cast Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard by paying {5}.
Repeat.

890-4659-5003-5295.notablePrerequisites: Nim Deathmantle attached to Palladium Myr.
890-4659-5003-5295.description:
Activate Palladium Myr by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Palladium Myr, adding {C}{C}.
Palladium Myr dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Palladium Myr from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

1308-2713-3094-3604-4659.description:
Cast Lithoform Engine by paying {4}.
LIthoform Engine enters the battlefield, triggering Cadric.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Cadric's trigger.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the copy of Cadric's trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create two token copies of Lithoform Engine.
Repeat from step 3.

1335-2440-3062.notablePrerequisites: Marath has at least three +1/+1 counters on it.
1335-2440-3062.description:
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Elemental creture token.
The Elemental enters the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes, adding {C} for each Elemental you control.
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite {C}, you may repeat step 3 to give Marath infinite +1/+1 counters, then use them to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

391-1636-2536-4328.notablePrerequisites:
You have exactly one or two {E}.
Blossom Dryad does not have summoning sickness.
391-1636-2536-4328.description:
Activate Aether Hub by paying {E} and tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Blossom Dryad by tapping it, untapping Aether Hub.
Cast Greenbelt Rampager by paying {G}.
Greenbelt Rampager enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Intruder Alarm.
Resolve the Greenbelt Rampager trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand and causing you to get {E}.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

122-328-1769-2438.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents.
122-328-1769-2438.description:
Cast Rot Hulk by paying {5}{B}{B}.
Rot Hulk enters the battlefield, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Rot Hulk, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Resolve Rot Hulk's trigger, returning Phyrexian Delver and Gray Merchant of Asphodel from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Gray Merchant of Asphodel and Phyrexian Delver enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Gray Merchant of Asphodel and Phyrexian Delver, putting two +1/+1 counters on Carrion Feeder.
Resolve the Gray Merchant of Asphodel trigger, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black, and causing you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Resolve the Phyrexian Delver trigger, returning Rot Hulk from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing yourself to lose 7 life.
Repeat from step 2.
